category.description: The detected product category. Drives which attributes are mandatory.

brand.description: Brand / maker (e.g. 'Roberto Coin'). Reuse an existing brand from get_reference_values when it matches; empty string if unknown.

title.description: Product title in Solist house style: Brand + Product Type + key spec (e.g. 'Roberto Coin Obelisco 18K Yellow Gold Diamond Bracelet'). Include the supplier reference/model number at the end if present.

description.description: Editorial product description, 2-4 short paragraphs of plain text (no HTML, no markdown). Luxury tone matching The Solist: evocative but factual. Never invent specifications not supported by the data or images.

bullet_points.description: 3-8 concise selling-point / spec bullets (plain text, no leading symbol). Each states one concrete detail a shopper cares about.

seo_title.description: SEO page title, <= 70 characters, front-loaded with brand + product type.

seo_description.description: SEO meta description, <= 160 characters, compelling and keyword-rich.

seo_keywords.description: 5-15 SEO keywords / search phrases relevant to this product.

shopify_tags.description: Shopify tags for filtering/merchandising. Reuse existing tags from get_reference_values where they apply; cover category, type, brand, material, gemstone, collection, gender as relevant.

shopify_category.description: Suggested Shopify Standard Product Taxonomy category name (e.g. 'Apparel & Accessories > Jewelry > Bracelets'). Empty string if unsure.

attributes.description: Structured attributes. Fill every field you can confidently determine from the description and photos for the detected category; omit or leave empty the ones that do not apply or cannot be determined (and list those you would expect but cannot fill in needs_review). Respect units: dimensions >1in in inches else mm; weight in grams; case size in mm; water resistance in metres.

dimensions.description: >1 inch in inches, <1 inch in mm.

weight.description: In grams, e.g. '44 g' (suitcases in pounds).

size.description: Ring size etc. — millimetres for ring size.

backstory.description: Short condition/provenance narrative, e.g. 'Pristine Display — Handled, Never Owned'.

color_and_clarity.description: Jewelry gemstone quality, e.g. 'Color: G-H; Clarity: VS-SI1'.

images.description: Generated editorial shots, one per generate_image call, in the order: hero, detail, angle, lifestyle, scale. Copy each tool result's {kind, brief, url} verbatim. Empty if item_code was unavailable or generation failed — note that in needs_review/notes instead of blocking the rest of the listing.

brief.description: The exact prompt passed to generate_image for this shot.

url.description: The file url returned by generate_image for this shot.

needs_review.description: Human-readable names of mandatory-for-category fields that could NOT be confidently filled and must be completed by the admin before publish (e.g. 'Water Resistance', 'Papers').

confidence.description: Overall confidence in the enrichment given the quality of the source data and images.

notes.description: Anything the admin should know: assumptions made, ambiguities, or data conflicts between the text and the photos.
